purpose: Extends the NdkSubscriber fixture with a waitForDuration method that collects relay events for a fixed window without rejecting on timeout, enabling wire-level A14 assertions in LgCommand and FdCommand.

public_api.name: waitForDuration
public_api.description: Subscribes to the relay, collects events matching filter for exactly ms milliseconds via setTimeout, then resolves with all collected events. NEVER rejects. Closes the subscription before resolving.

public_api.name: getNostrGroupIdHex
public_api.description: Added to e2e/fixtures/two-party.ts. Reads window.__notestrTestGroups(), finds the entry with matching idStr, and returns its nostrGroupIdHex. Throws if not found.

owned_data: NDK instance lifecycle within openNdkSubscriber closure
events_consumed: kind:445 Nostr events (MLS commits) filtered by #h tag
test_targets: tsc --noEmit (type contract for waitForDuration and getNostrGroupIdHex)
